latest.name: GridResolveAIWorkflow
latest.description: v10: every agent node passes an explicit, role-specific input message, and the release gate also requires the evidence, usage, policy and compliance outputs to be structured. Nothing else changed from v9.

definition.name: GridResolveAIWorkflow
definition.workflow:
kind: workflow
trigger:
  kind: OnConversationStart
  id: trigger_wf
  actions:
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789696603365
      agent:
        name: CaseTriageAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 1 of 9: CaseTriageAgent. Task: classify the case in the first user message, state the customer concern and the material allegations, and list the investigation steps required. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Do not describe what you will do. Respond now, in this single reply, with only the JSON object your OUTPUT contract requires, starting with an opening brace."
      output:
        autoSend: false
        messages: Local.VarTriage
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789696645054
      agent:
        name: AccountEvidenceAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 2 of 9: AccountEvidenceAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Task: build the evidence ledger for the case in the first user message, using only its synthetic_account_records. Record the billing records, the read type of each meter read, meter events and diagnostics as evidence entries with evidence identifiers, and list anything missing or contradictory. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Do not describe what you will do. Respond now, in this single reply, with only the JSON object your OUTPUT contract requires, including evidence_ledger."
      output:
        autoSend: false
        messages: Local.VarEvidence
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789696697430
      agent:
        name: UsageAnomalyAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 3 of 9: UsageAnomalyAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Task: compare consumption and billing across the periods in the case records, using the step 2 evidence ledger where one is present and the case records in the first user message otherwise. State separately which explanations the evidence supports and which it does not. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Do not describe what you will do. Respond now, in this single reply, with only the JSON object your OUTPUT contract requires, starting with an opening brace."
      output:
        autoSend: false
        messages: Local.VarUsage
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789696718717
      agent:
        name: PolicyKnowledgeAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 4 of 9: PolicyKnowledgeAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Task: map the governed policies in your policy ledger to this case. Give the policy identifiers that apply, the conditions any statement about the meter must meet, and the requirements for adjustments and for human approval. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Do not describe what you will do. Respond now, in this single reply, with only the JSON object your OUTPUT contract requires, including policy_ledger."
      output:
        autoSend: false
        messages: Local.VarPolicy
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789696778418
      agent:
        name: ResolutionPlannerAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 5 of 9: ResolutionPlannerAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Task: propose a resolution supported by the step 2 evidence, step 3 usage and step 4 policy outputs above, giving the evidence and policy basis for every claim. If one of those outputs is missing or is not a JSON object, say so in the plan and do not fill the gap yourself. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Do not describe what you will do. Respond now, in this single reply, with the JSON object your OUTPUT contract requires, starting with an opening brace, followed by the single CASE_FOLLOWUP token line your instructions define."
      output:
        autoSend: false
        messages: Local.VarPlan
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789696813306
      agent:
        name: CustomerCommunicationAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 6 of 9: CustomerCommunicationAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Task: write the customer message from the claims the step 5 plan supports. Complete all six customer-facing fields in plain language that stands on its own. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Respond now, in this single reply, with the JSON object your output schema requires."
      output:
        autoSend: false
        messages: Local.VarCustomerDraft
        responseObject: Local.VarCustomerMessage
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789696841174
      agent:
        name: EvidenceComplianceAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 7 of 9: EvidenceComplianceAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Task: review the customer message drafted in step 6 against the step 2 evidence, step 3 usage, step 4 policy and step 5 plan outputs above. Run your checks and record which failed, with reasons. Decide only whether that message is safe to release. Whether the underlying case still needs a person is decided separately by the workflow, and is not by itself a reason to reject a message that is otherwise safe. If an output you need is missing or is not a JSON object, record that as a failed check and do not repair it. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Respond now, in this single reply, with the JSON decision object your OUTPUT contract requires, starting with an opening brace, followed by the single ROUTE_DECISION token line your instructions define. The token line alone is not a complete response."
      output:
        autoSend: false
        messages: Local.Var1497
    - kind: ConditionGroup
      id: node-1789696874113
      conditions:
        - condition: '=And(With({t: Last(Local.Var1497).Text}, With({l: Trim(Last(Filter(Split(Substitute(t, Char(13), ""), Char(10)), !IsBlank(Trim(Value)))).Value)}, !IsBlank(t) && !("GRIDRESOLVE_ESCALATE" in t) && (Len(t) - Len(Substitute(t, "ROUTE_DECISION::GRIDRESOLVE_APPROVED", "")) = Len("ROUTE_DECISION::GRIDRESOLVE_APPROVED")) && ("ROUTE_DECISION::GRIDRESOLVE_APPROVED" exactin l) && (Len(l) = Len("ROUTE_DECISION::GRIDRESOLVE_APPROVED")))), !IsBlank(Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Local.VarCustomerMessage.customer_summary, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))) && !IsBlank(Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Local.VarCustomerMessage.what_we_reviewed, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))) && !IsBlank(Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Local.VarCustomerMessage.what_we_found, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))) && !IsBlank(Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Local.VarCustomerMessage.why_bill_changed, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))) && !IsBlank(Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Local.VarCustomerMessage.what_happens_next, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))) && !IsBlank(Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Local.VarCustomerMessage.customer_action_needed, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))), With({s: Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Last(Local.VarEvidence).Text, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))}, StartsWith(s, "{") && ("""evidence_id""" in s)) && With({s: Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Last(Local.VarUsage).Text, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))}, StartsWith(s, "{") && ("""usage_summary""" in s)) && With({s: Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Last(Local.VarPolicy).Text, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))}, StartsWith(s, "{") && ("""policy_id""" in s)) && With({s: Trim(Substitute(Substitute(Substitute(Last(Local.Var1497).Text, Char(10), ""), Char(13), ""), Char(9), ""))}, StartsWith(s, "{") && ("""decision""" in s)))'
          id: if-node-approved-release
          actions:
            - kind: SendActivity
              id: node-release-approved-message
              activity: |-
                {Local.VarCustomerMessage.customer_summary}

                What we reviewed
                {Local.VarCustomerMessage.what_we_reviewed}

                What we found
                {Local.VarCustomerMessage.what_we_found}

                Why your bill changed
                {Local.VarCustomerMessage.why_bill_changed}

                What happens next
                {Local.VarCustomerMessage.what_happens_next}

                What we need from you
                {Local.VarCustomerMessage.customer_action_needed}
            - kind: ConditionGroup
              id: node-case-followup-gate
              conditions:
                - condition: '=With({t: Last(Local.VarPlan).Text}, With({l: Trim(Last(Filter(Split(Substitute(t, Char(13), ""), Char(10)), !IsBlank(Trim(Value)))).Value)}, !IsBlank(t) && !("CASE_FOLLOWUP::HUMAN_REQUIRED" in t) && (Len(t) - Len(Substitute(t, "CASE_FOLLOWUP::NONE_REQUIRED", "")) = Len("CASE_FOLLOWUP::NONE_REQUIRED")) && ("CASE_FOLLOWUP::NONE_REQUIRED" exactin l) && (Len(l) = Len("CASE_FOLLOWUP::NONE_REQUIRED"))))'
                  id: if-node-no-human-followup
                  actions:
                    - kind: SetVariable
                      id: node-record-no-followup
                      variable: Local.VarCaseFollowUp
                      value: ="NONE_REQUIRED"
                - condition: "true"
                  id: if-node-human-followup
                  actions:
                    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
                      id: node-followup-handoff
                      agent:
                        name: EscalationCoordinatorAgent
                      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
                      input:
                        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 8 of 9: EscalationCoordinatorAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Workflow state: the customer message was approved and released, and the step 5 follow-up line did not clear the case of further human work. Task: prepare the human review package for the open case work. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Do not describe what you will do. Respond now, in this single reply, with only the JSON object your OUTPUT contract requires, starting with an opening brace."
                      output:
                        autoSend: true
                        messages: Local.VarFollowUpHandoff
        - condition: "true"
          id: if-node-failclosed-escalate
          actions:
            - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
              id: node-1789697115060
              agent:
                name: EscalationCoordinatorAgent
              conversationId: =System.ConversationId
              input:
                messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 8 of 9: EscalationCoordinatorAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Workflow state: the customer message was not released. Either the step 7 review did not approve it, or a required specialist output or customer field was incomplete. Nothing has been sent to the customer. Task: prepare the human review package, and list any specialist output above that is missing or is not a JSON object. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Do not describe what you will do. Respond now, in this single reply, with only the JSON object your OUTPUT contract requires, starting with an opening brace."
              output:
                autoSend: true
                messages: Local.VarEscalation
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: node-1789697069548
      agent:
        name: CaseAuditAgent
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: "WORKFLOW STEP 9 of 9: CaseAuditAgent. Every assistant message above was written by a different specialist agent, not by you. Task: write the terminal audit record from the conversation above. Each specialist output follows a WORKFLOW STEP message naming the agent that wrote it. Record an agent as invoked only if a WORKFLOW STEP message names it, and as NOT_INVOKED only if none does. Record an output as RECEIVED only if it is a JSON object, and as MISSING_OR_MALFORMED otherwise. Copy the compliance decision from the step 7 output and its final ROUTE_DECISION line, never from the wording of the customer message. Record every fact you cannot read in this conversation, including every agent version, as NOT_OBSERVED. No operator is present and no confirmation will be given. Respond now, in this single reply, with only the JSON object your output contract requires."
      output:
        autoSend: true
        messages: Local.VarAudit
id: ""
name: GridResolveAIWorkflow
